title: uva-ursi tomentosa
intro: Uva-ursi tomentosa, commonly known as bearberry, is a small evergreen shrub native to boreal forests in Europe, Asia, and North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the relief of urinary tract infections and inflammation due to its astringent properties. Bearberry's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit bacterial growth, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Uva-ursi tomentosa include arbutin, ursolic acid, and betulinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
